session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Channel after New All-time High, Minor Reversal, Trading Range' (ET+13 hrs, Jan 28/29; inset Upper Trading Range Breakout Failure T-W). New all-time high at the open (7030) reversed into consecutive trading range breakouts in a bear channel down to 6996, two legs up to the bear channel trendline, the FOMC statement and press conference bars (minimal impact, bear trend resumption failed at 7013, limit order market scalp setups), and the final wedge sell-off testing Monday's close.
